verdict.rationale: A state business-filing agency could plausibly offer a machine channel (API or bulk filing interface) with a public test environment, so the axis applies. The evidence pack documents only human-facing web portals, downloadable forms, live chat and an in-person counter. Nothing describes an API, sandbox or test environment for end-to-end trial filings.

support.subject: As a developer, a public sandbox or test environment for the service's machine channel is documented — I can exercise the rail end to end before touching production
